scripts.dev: concurrently -k -s first -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:3000/health && npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run preflight:desktop && concurrently -k -s first -n api,web,desktop -c blue,green,cyan "npm run dev:api" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:3000/health && npm run dev:web" "wait-on http-get://127.0.0.1:5173 && npm --prefix apps/desktop run tauri -- dev"
scripts.backup:run: npm run build -w @maktaba/api && npm run backup:run -w @maktaba/api
scripts.backup:verify: npm run build -w @maktaba/api && npm run backup:verify -w @maktaba/api
scripts.backup:retention: npm run build -w @maktaba/api && npm run backup:retention -w @maktaba/api
